The '''fur mite''' was a type of [[Parasite/Legends|parasite]] that lived on [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]].<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The fur mite was introduced in ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Platt" />
